in_hebrew.name: איסולינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: איסולינה הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בשורשים יווניים ומשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא הבורא, האור שלי'. השם נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'איסוס', שפירושה 'אלוהים' ומילה שפירושה 'אור'. השם משקף את האמונה הנוצרית באלוהים כמקור האור והחיים.

in_greek.name: Ισολίνη
in_greek.meaning: Θεός είναι ο Δημιουργός, το Φως μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ισολίνη έχει τις ρίζες του στην ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Θεός είναι ο Δημιουργός, το Φως μου'. Η λέξη προέρχεται από το 'Ισός', που σημαίνει 'Θεός' και μια λέξη που σημαίνει 'φως'. Το όνομα αντανακλά την χριστιανική πίστη στον Θεό ως πηγή φωτός και ζωής.

in_latin.name: Isolina
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Isolina origine suo in linguam latinam significat 'Deus est creator, lux mea'. Verbum 'Deus' est radix nominis et 'lux' est secundum verbum. Nomen hoc reflectit fidem christianam in Deum ut fontem lucis et vitae.

historical_references.reference: Isolina of Hippo (d. 436 AD) was a North African Christian saint, a nun, and a virgin martyr. She was born in what is now Algeria and grew up in a Christian family. After her mother's death, she decided to dedicate her life to God and became a nun. She was captured by Vandals during the invasion of North Africa in 431 AD, and was tortured and killed for her faith. Her relics were later interred in the monastery of Sidi Abderrahman, near Algiers.
historical_references.context: Christian martyr and saint from North Africa during the Vandal invasion

historical_references.reference: Isolde of Wales (late 12th century) is a legendary figure from Welsh folklore, believed to have been a fair and beautiful woman. Her story was popularized in a series of poems and ballads, most famously in the 13th-century romance 'Tristan and Isolde'. According to the legend, Isolde fell in love with Tristan, a knight from Cornwall, after they drank a love potion during a hunting trip. Their love was complicated by a promise Isolde had made to marry another man. The tragic story of their ill-fated love became a popular theme in European literature.
historical_references.context: Legendary figure from Welsh folklore and popular subject of European literature
